label: For every interpretation and ought-to-adopt policy, if a specified objective-duty content is true…
paraphrase: For every interpretation and ought-to-adopt policy, if a specified objective-duty content is true at the designated actual world, and every worldview selected by that policy is true at that world (the explicit truth-directed bridge), then the policy satisfies both the consistency norm and the separate duty-compatibility norm; each selected worldview is also jointly compatible with every semantic consequence of the duty. The result is conditional: the stronger truth-directed premise is not entailed by consistency alone, and no actual duty or deontic principle is proven.
